brand.name: Paysafecard
brand.description: Give the gift of online shopping and gaming with a Paysafecard gift card. This prepaid voucher allows the recipient to make secure payments on thousands of websites without revealing personal or financial information. Simply enter the unique code at checkout to redeem the card. Get a Paysafecard gift card today and give the gift of convenience and security.

products.name: Paysafecard DE
products.redemption_instructions: Once you have received your paysafecard PIN, use the 16-digit pin code to top up your Paysafecard account. You can then pay without having a bank account or credit card. Your personal and bank details are safe.
products.terms: Service fee: From the 2nd month, a monthly service fee of 3 on the currency amount will be deducted from the residual credit of the PaysafeCard prepaid code.
